body: U+0023# pacer-fixes built and verified; PR #247 updated (2026-10-01)U+000AU+000AU+002D The pacer-fixes mitosis run built branch mitosis/meadow-recolour-fixes at 18492bd. Gate 5/5 pass, reconcile clean.U+000AU+002D Full suite: 31 groups pass, plus Impeller on both engines, analyze and the Edmonton goldens.U+000AU+002D Lab emulator (two runs): page and study longest frames 37-97 ms; scene ready 429-754 ms.U+000AU+002D Lab Mac VM (Metal): ready 258-436 ms in every case; opens fully coloured; the study time slider settles to the same colours (noon before and after 6 PM within 1/255 per region).U+000A  U+002D The VM's two first-case long frames, 162 and 265 ms, are the virtual GPU's first-use cost; main shows the same cases worse.U+000AU+002D Note10+, run 2, one clean pass: 12/12 cases meet 10.17. 60 fps, longest frame 47-89 ms, ready 645-843 ms, largest batch 27-50 ms, the pacer never waited.U+000A  U+002D Run 1 was interrupted: the phone went to its home screen and the bench restarted, so it was discarded.U+000A  U+002D The real app was absent before and after; the bench app was uninstalled.U+000AU+002D With the owner's approval, the branch was fast-forward pushed to PR #247 (3a47919..18492bd) and the PR description was replaced. The PR is still a draft; 2 CI checks were pending at the time of writing.U+000AU+002D Open: per-kind estimates still let one batch run 2-3x its share when a kind's steps differ in size (spec open question). It did not break 100 ms on any device tested.
